headline: Quiet night: NY high hit 11-06 (70, err 0.00); NY low missed 11-06 (CLI 60 at 11:59 PM vs our non-binding 62+ at 0.54, market's 60-61 won). No bug, no fix; the low trail flipped 5 times 15:21-15:55 on an alternating HRRR/GFS feed.

findings.title: NY low 11-06 missed on a non-binding lock
findings.evidence: kalshi_low_ny.json lock 08:00 pred 61.7 sd 1.915 '62 or above' p 0.5373 binding false; CLI low 60 at 11:59 PM; market '60 to 61' 0.415; live 38/54 vs market 43/54

findings.title: Low pick flipped 5x after noon on a model-feed flicker
findings.evidence: ny_low_2026-11-06 trail 15:21-15:55: HRRR/GFS 62.5 vs 64.2 alternating, pred 61.2/61.62 vs floor 61.62, bind = fl >= pf (kalshi_lows.py:357) toggles sd 1.989/0.643; low court shut, no bet

findings.evidence: ny_high_2026-11-06 00:00-00:50 '67 to 68' p 0.66-0.71, NO on winner 69-70 shown 00:00-00:15, 23:51 report 68; 9 of 18 days p>0.6 on a loser in this window; ungraded
